rows.text: fills the 4x4 byte block at `rcx` (cell (r, c) at rcx + r times `rdx` + c) from `t0`..`t3` = bytes [r9] to [r9+3] and `L`, `u0`, `u1`, `u2` = bytes [r8-1] to [r8+2], all eight read before any store, with h(x, y) = (x + y + 1) >> 1 and q(x, y, z) = (x + 2y + z + 2) >> 2: (0,0) and (1,2) = h(t0, L); (1,0) and (2,2) = h(t0, t1); (2,0) and (3,2) = h(t1, t2); (3,0) = h(t2, t3); (0,3) = q(u0, u1, u2); (0,2) = q(L, u0, u1); (0,1) and (1,3) = q(t0, L, u0); (1,1) and (2,3) = q(L, t0, t1); (2,1) and (3,3) = q(t0, t1, t2); (3,1) = q(t1, t2, t3)
